headline: Sky Blue is the correct pick under the active November promotion, but the script never confirms the business meets Sky Blue's 4-year startup age limit.

issues.summary: Sky Blue is a startup account restricted to companies within 4 years of formation, and the customer script never says how old the business is. The promotion only applies among accounts the customer qualifies for, so the gold silently assumes eligibility.
evidence: doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_001: "Confirm your company is within 4 years of formation."
doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_008: "Eligibility criteria tied to company age are evaluated when you open the account; the threshold is 4."
user_scenario.instructions: no formation date or company age is given
simulation_guidelines_tools.md: "Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable."
issues.why_it_matters: A careful agent that asks the company age gets no grounded answer: the script gives none, and the simulator treats unscripted facts as unknown, so the customer cannot confirm eligibility. An agent that will not open Sky Blue unconfirmed falls back to Lime Green (next in the promotion, no age limit) and fails the gold. Most agents will not ask, so the effect is limited.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a line to the script stating the business was formed within the last 4 years (e.g., "I started the agency 2 years ago").

solution_check: Requirements: ATM rebates >= $15/month, $0 overdraft fee, minimum balance < $10,000, APY >= 1%. Qualifiers: Sky Blue (rebates 15, overdraft $0, funding requirement 0, APY 1.25%), Lime Green (rebates $25, $0, $5,000, 1.5%), Hunter Green (rebates $20, $0, $5,000 waiver, 1.0%). Clock 11/14/2025 falls in the November promotion (11/01-11/30, Sky Blue first) and after the October one (ended 11/12). Eligibility per doc_003 holds (personal Green checking OPEN, $2,850, no CLOSED accounts). Gold Sky Blue matches; skipping get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 fails as a missing required read.
prior_note: Prior review rated the task clean; the company-age gap is a new, minor finding.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against the snapshot: gold replay + hash compare (evaluator_env.py); read logging only for gold-named discoverable reads (_derive_read_log_allowlist, call_discoverable_agent_tool); parse_int=float on discoverable args; apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float. Verified scorer (working-repo _verified_db_match) compares agent_discoverable_tools by tool-name set only and strips accounts.closure_reason; all other tables exact. Replays used the grep_only retrieval variant (no embeddings needed) with the gold-derived allowlist. Business checking account_class "Sky Blue" (no "Account" suffix) follows doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_003 ("options include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue"). v1.0.1 changes to Sky Blue docs 001/002/009 were cosmetic ($120 -> 120 regions, "6." -> "6 months.").
